prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Soldier survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the exact approved single-facing shipped seed and locks this camera/facing. Image 2 is the four-view identity authority for costume/face details only; do not substitute any other facing from it. Preserve the same young adult woman Mara Rook, chin-length wavy chestnut hair, dark navy peaked officer cap with a small brass badge/band, ragged long split navy-blue officer coat with restrained brass trim and a sleeve crest, charcoal trousers, brown leather lace-up boots and gloves, utility belt pouches, small brass belt chain and one cross-body strap matching the reference. ONE compact dark brass pistol stays in the physical RIGHT trigger hand with the LEFT hand supporting the grip. Keep the same compact pistol, two arms, face and cap in every pose; no rifle, second pistol, sword, holster swap, new hat, mirrored strap or added ornament. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet color planes and selective practical contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive tiny scratches, decorative filigree or noise. Maintain two arms, two legs and one intact body/weapon in every pose.
Every pose faces NORTH, away from the viewer. We see back of hair/coat/cape, never the face. Retain the exact original back-facing equipment placement. The gun is partly hidden naturally in front of the body, with its visible portion matching the seed. Preserve physical RIGHT trigger and LEFT support grip; do not mirror straps or belt.
Draw EXACTLY 4 full-body poses as one coherent idle sheet, arranged in one horizontal row of 4 complete poses on a wide transparent canvas. No additional figure. Action: A quiet planted breathing cycle: 1 upright ready pose matching the seed, 2 slight inhale through shoulders, 3 gentle weight settlement, 4 return toward pose 1. Boots stay planted. Keep the original two-handed aimed-ready weapon hold; only subtle cloth movement, no walk, shot or new grip.
Every pose is one complete independent drawn body at ONE common character scale calibrated from upright pose 1. Crouched and resting poses retain their naturally lower height. Use roomy clear gutters between all cells and generous padding around the ENTIRE body/weapon/cape, with a consistent ground baseline in each row. Genuine RGBA transparency: alpha zero outside each figure and between limbs/props. No floor, shadow, backdrop, haze, vignette, glow, particles, checker pattern, text, labels, frame numbers or grid lines. Keep a coherent animation rather than unrelated character illustrations.
